title: Use Seedance 2.0 face input to lock facial consistency across multilingual dubs…
content: Use Seedance 2.0 face input to lock facial consistency across multilingual dubs so the spokesperson’s face doesn’t change when switching audio languages
tips: Use Seedance 2.0 face input to lock facial consistency across multilingual dubs so the spokesperson’s face doesn’t change when switching audio languages

es.content: Utiliza la entrada facial de Seedance 2.0 para mantener la consistencia facial en doblajes multilingües, de modo que el rostro del portavoz no cambie al cambiar los idiomas de audio.

fr.content: Utilisez l'entrée faciale de Seedance 2.0 pour maintenir la cohérence faciale à travers les doublages multilingues afin que le visage du porte-parole ne change pas lors du changement de langue audio.

ja.content: Seedance 2.0の顔入力を使用して、多言語吹き替えで顔の一貫性を保ち、音声言語を切り替えてもスポークスパーソンの顔が変わらないようにします。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0 얼굴 입력을 사용하여 다국어 더빙에서 얼굴 일관성을 유지함으로써 오디오 언어를 전환할 때 발표자의 얼굴이 변하지 않도록 합니다.

pt.content: Use a entrada facial do Seedance 2.0 para manter a consistência facial em dublagens multilíngues, garantindo que o rosto do porta-voz não mude ao alternar os idiomas de áudio.

zh.content: 使用Seedance 2.0面部输入功能，在多语言配音中保持面部一致性，以确保在切换音频语言时代言人的面部不会发生变化。
